axes.name: Amass and the Goblin Army
axes.definition: A card that amasses Goblins or otherwise puts +1/+1 counters on a Goblin, Orc or Army you control, growing the one Army that Great Ugly-Looking Goblin, The Great Goblin, Goblin Plate Mail and Goblin-town reward.

axes.name: Goblin creatures
axes.definition: A Goblin creature or a card that makes one (the Army token counts), feeding cards that check for or sacrifice another Goblin such as Bolg's Company, The Great Goblin, Along the Crooked Way and Goblin-town.

axes.name: Second card each turn
axes.definition: A card that draws you a card beyond your draw step on demand: recruit, looting, cantrips, draw-two effects and repeatable draw abilities, which turn on Lakeshore Apothecary, Master's Councillors, Bard the Bowman, Lake-town Toymaker and Ravenhill Flock.

axes.name: Creature tokens and wide boards
axes.definition: A card that creates creature tokens (recruit Soldiers, Dwarf tokens, Elf tokens, Wolf and Bear tokens) or several cheap bodies, rewarded by token triggers and team-wide effects such as Belladonna Took, Bard King of Dale, Eagle of the Great Shelf, Esgaroth Garrison, Dwarven Provisioner and the anthems.

axes.name: Storied: artifacts, legendaries and Sagas
axes.definition: A permanent that is an artifact, legendary or a Saga, or a card that makes one (Treasures, Equipment tokens, Axes), counting toward the three needed for an enduring story on the nine storied cards.

axes.name: Equipment
axes.definition: An Equipment card or a card that creates an Equipment token, which Vow to Erebor, Kili, Dwarven Mauler, Iron Hills Stalwart, Thorin Mountain-king, Dain Ironfoot, Dwalin, Dain's Company and The Lonely Mountain reward.

axes.name: Dwarf creatures
axes.definition: A Dwarf creature or a card that makes a Dwarf token, triggering or enabling Fili, Kili, Balin, Bifur, Dain's Company, Dwarven Mattock, Vow to Erebor and Iron Hills.

axes.name: Ferocious: power 4 or greater
axes.definition: A creature with power 4 or greater, or a card that reliably makes one (large Bears, Giants, big pump and counters), which turns on the six ferocious cards and Stone by Sunlight's first mode.

axes.name: Wolves, Bears and Spiders
axes.definition: A creature that is a Wolf, Bear or Spider, or a card that makes a Wolf or Bear token, which Beorn the Fierce, Little Bear, Bejeweled Warg, Chief Warg's Company and Mirkwood reward.

axes.name: Elf creatures
axes.definition: An Elf creature or a card that makes Elf tokens, rewarded by Woodland Weavemaster, both Thranduils, Thranduil's Company, Cantankerous Keepers, Down in the Valley, Elvenking's Halls and Elven Passage.

axes.name: Landfall: lands entering
axes.definition: A card that puts extra lands onto the battlefield or lets you play more of them: extra land drops, land fetch to the battlefield, lands returned to hand or flickered, and land-finding, which triggers the nine landfall cards and Last Light of Durin's Day.

axes.name: Treasure tokens
axes.definition: A card that creates Treasure tokens, which both Smaugs, The Misty Mountains Cold, Fateful Discovery, storied, and the artifact-sacrifice costs on Stone-Giant, Stir Up Trouble, Snowslope Hunter and Gollum the Abandoned reward.

axes.name: Expendable creatures and death triggers
axes.definition: A creature or artifact that is cheap to lose or wants to die: tokens, death-trigger creatures like Fearsome Goblin Pair, Front Porch Sentries and Lake-town Lookout, and Treasures, feeding sacrifice outlets (Stir Up Trouble, Bolg, Rhovanion Rampager, Snowslope Hunter, Tom Bert and William, Allure of Power) and creature-died payoffs (Great Fierce Bee, Dreaded Bat-Cloud, The Great Goblin).

axes.name: Filling your graveyard
axes.definition: A card that puts cards from your library or hand into your graveyard (self-mill, recruit and looting discards, flashback cards, Adventures and spells that die), which threshold, Master's Councillors, The Master of Lake-town, Bilbo Thief in the Night, Gathering of Darkness, Along the Crooked Way, The Mountain-king's Return, Thranduil the Elvenking and the flashback spells reward.

axes.name: Casting noncreature spells
axes.definition: A cheap instant, sorcery, Adventure half, artifact or enchantment you cast, triggering Bothersome Noisemaker, Gandalf Goblins' Bane, Wizard's Staff prowess, Uncover the Moon-Letters and discounted by Glamdring.
